limitations.blocked_by: The measure session only returned facts already given (bolt head ~15 x ~5 mm, ~10 mm under head; clamp style description) — no caliper numbers for the clamp jaws or camera
limitations.wanted: Caliper measurements of the tripod clamp (jaw gap closed/open, mouth depth, floor length) and the camera (base footprint, socket position, socket depth) — these directly set the plate's width and length
limitations.why: The plate width must match the clamp's grip width and the length must fit the clamp channel; without them I fall back to the RC2-family standard (39 mm) plus a printed fit comb and sand/tape remedies

limitations.blocked_by: Material/process: PLA on a 0.4 mm FDM printer can't make a reliable 1/4-20 thread (strips, wears, binds in a metal camera socket)
limitations.wanted: Print the "part that screws in" (the 1/4-20 camera screw) as printed plastic in one piece with the plate
limitations.why: The user asked to print both parts; the salvaged webcam-mount bolt is the same 1/4-20 thread and does that job properly, so the plate only needs a pocket for its head

findings.detail: 39.0 mm wide, narrowing by 0.9 mm on both edges
no hole runs through the plate
